latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of abstract-factory-implementor

- Implements the Abstract Factory pattern for creating families of related objects without specifying concrete classes.
- Supports scenarios including factory-as-singleton, prototype-based factories, and extensible factory interfaces.
- Provides guidance to map product families, define abstract product and factory interfaces, and implement concrete factories.
- Describes decision gates for when Abstract Factory is the right pattern, and alternative approaches for simpler or more complex needs.
- Language-agnostic process with examples referencing C++ and Python.
